provenance.notes: Easy-tier one-molecule set showcasing acceptor-only h_bond + pi_stacking (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 3, APPROVED 2026-09-26): caffeine CID 2519. Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID 2519; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/2519'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB).

Caffeine (1,3,7-trimethylxanthine), PubChem CID 2519 (C8H10N4O2, 14 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded). Complex: 3G6M chitinase CrChi1-caffeine (CFF in inventory, verified 2026-09-26; paper DOI human-verified via PDB website). h_bond ACCEPTOR-ONLY (2 carbonyl O + 4 ring N; every ring N methylated so no N-H donor - a clean direction-refined-typing teaching case), pi_stacking (fused purine rings), hydrophobic. GEN-06 diversity: the acceptor-only case has no other easy-tier carrier.
